title: Seedling Vigor Assessment Protocol
author: Zhenbin Hu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jc2ciye

steps.title: Establish Vigor Standard Plots
steps.instruction: Identify five plots in the field to serve as standards representing a score range from 1 to 5.

steps.title: Phenotype Seedling Vigor
steps.instruction: Perform seedling vigor phenotyping by comparing seedlings against the established standard plots.

steps.title: Assign Vigor Scores
steps.instruction: Assign a score between 1 and 5 to each plot based on the scale developed from the standard plots.
